terminal_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains a fault in the upstream provenance handoff. The required provenance order is demand-descending, matching the selected corpus records, but Job 2 received evidence_sources with ranks effectively reversed/misordered, putting n06-r08 first and n06-r01 last. The captured upstream assemble_provenance function explains this: it sorts by demand_score ascending before assigning rank, so the downstream job preserves corrupted upstream ranks and recommends n06-r07 ahead of the higher-demand unsupported n06-r01.
